proposed_facts.reason: Canonical signature and returns establish a state-changing predicate reporting entry dispatch, not verified completion.
DownWait_IASA calls this selector; its body reads input without clearing it and uses exact DownWaitU equality with an unrestricted D fallback.
The complete guard, inclusive comparisons, short-circuit structure and returns match source. The angle helper independently confirms atan2f(Y, ABS(X)).
Input, timeout and non-air damage-completion callers are present. The wrapper forwards the stated arguments, and the consumer interprets zero blend as metadata default.
Object and motion ID are forwarded unchanged. NULL selects the receiving fighter's animation data; conditional animation setup uses the metadata blend default.
The wrapper has no local eligibility or range guard. Motion machinery copies the selected entry's callback pointers; zero blend does not force zero duration.
IASA has an empty body and is assigned to both DownStand entries. The proposal appropriately avoids mandatory-slot or global interruptibility claims.
IASA ignores its argument. Sibling animation dispatch and delegated conditional Fall entry establish other exit paths.
Local flow and the independently read angle helper support signed-Y input, exact selection, argument forwarding and borrowed-object delegation.

Canonical implementation, both table entries, callers, blend consumer, physics helper and collision helper support the integrated behavior. Grounded damage completion is understood as the documented non-air branch.

contradictions.reason: Accept the input supersessions: true reports dispatch, input is not consumed, signed Y is not magnitude, and every non-DownWaitU motion selects D. Existing inferred CheckInput and Enter names remain useful hypotheses, not canonical proof.

Accept correction of no-blend claims and preserve requested-start versus internal-frame distinction. Accept deferral of all three pool claims: source literals cannot prove compiled .sdata2 attribution, size, ordering or placement, and actual blend duration needs animation metadata.

Accept expanded caller coverage: DownWait expiration is an automatic entry path; DownDamage requires animation exhaustion, non-air state and expired timer, with other branches preserved. These paths do not independently establish detailed visible reset or orientation mappings.

Accept deferral of detailed gameplay mappings for the selector, entry, animation, collision, physics and file, including the unresolved wiki link. Tables and callbacks establish internal down-state standing recovery, not independently verified visible face orientation or wiki-specific neutral-get-up behavior.

Accept IASA supersessions and global-interruption deferral. An assigned empty callback proves neither mandatory design intent nor immunity to interruption. Conditional collision Fall entry defeats a guaranteed sole or eventual animation exit; the collision predicate's physical interpretation remains deferred.

Accept physics deferral: direct delegation and strict above-walk-speed friction scaling are supported, but universal deceleration and absence of transitions throughout nested helpers are not established for arbitrary exceptional attributes. The rendered physics alias is corroborated only at this delegation level.
